title: MetaGit Commit Service
description: Standardized Git commit wrapper for the multi-git ecosystem.

values.name: Identity Verification
values.rule: Always verify user.name and user.email match the session identity before committing.
values.rationale: Ensures forensic traceability and prevents identity leakage.

values.name: Secret Scanning
values.rule: Run detect-secrets on all staged changes.
values.rationale: Prevents accidental leakage of credentials into version control.

values.name: Size Management
values.rule: Block large blobs (>5MB) from standard Git tracking.
values.rationale: Maintains a lean source repository and aligns with Linus-aligned Git philosophy.
